Mehnat rang lati hai.
Success aakhri nahi, failure maut nahi: aage badhne ki himmat hi maine rakhti hai.
Shak dushman nahi; darr dushman hai.
Himmat endure karne ki ability hai.
Himmat wisdom ki shuruaat hai.
Grit andar se khojne ka naam hai.
Himmat growth choose karti hai.
Grit kacchi dridh-ta hai.
Grit andar ki aag hai.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Khamoshi ultimate weapon hai.
Chuppi takat ka srot hai.
Jab alfaaz na kaam karein, khamoshi bolti.
Grit gehri hai.
Himmat hamesha cheekhti nahi.
Ek saaf aur shaant zameer insaan ko majboot banata hai.
Lagan sab kuch jeet leti hai.
Khamoshi ko aagyanta, shaanti ko swikaar, aur daayaluat ko kamzori mat samjho.
Himmat chod dene ki taqat hai.
